title: Transpose calculation for a normalized adjunction square with arbitrary comparison maps
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal A_v,\mathcal B_v,\mathcal E,\mathcal F,\mathcal E_v,\mathcal F_v$ be categories. Fix functors $q_A:\mathcal A\to\mathcal E$, $q_B:\mathcal B\to\mathcal F$, $q_{A_v}:\mathcal A_v\to\mathcal E_v$, $q_{B_v}:\mathcal B_v\to\mathcal F_v$, $r_0:\mathcal A\to\mathcal A_v$, $s_0:\mathcal B\to\mathcal B_v$, $r:\mathcal E\to\mathcal E_v$, $s:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F_v$, and $G_v:\mathcal B_v\to\mathcal A_v$. Use the unit and Hom-transpose conventions of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Fix adjunctions $F:\mathcal A\rightleftarrows\mathcal B:G$, $L:\mathcal E\rightleftarrows\mathcal F:R$, $L_v:\mathcal E_v\rightleftarrows\mathcal F_v:R_v$, with units $\eta^0,\eta,\eta_v$ and Hom bijections $\mathsf T_0,\mathsf T_D,\mathsf T_v$ from left-adjoint morphisms to right-adjoint morphisms. Write $a;b$ for first $a$, then $b$.
Fix natural transformations $\alpha:Lq_A\to q_BF$, $\iota:q_AG\to Rq_B$, $\iota_v:q_{A_v}G_v\to R_vq_{B_v}$, $\tau:r_0G\to G_vs_0$, $\theta:L_vr\to sL$, $\beta:rR\to R_vs$, and natural isomorphisms $\rho:rq_A\cong q_{A_v}r_0$, $\zeta:sq_B\cong q_{B_v}s_0$. Suppose for every $A\in\mathcal A$, $I\in\mathcal B$ and $h:FA\to I$ the global Hom normalization holds:
$$\mathsf T_D(\alpha_A;q_Bh)=q_A(\mathsf T_0(h));\iota_I.$$
Suppose also, for all $X\in\mathcal E$ and $I\in\mathcal B$,
$$\eta_{v,rX};R_v(\theta_X)=r(\eta_X);\beta_{LX},$$
$$r(\iota_I);\beta_{q_BI};R_v(\zeta_I)=\rho_{GI};q_{A_v}(\tau_I);\iota_{v,s_0I}.$$
Then for every $A\in\mathcal A$ one has the following equality of morphisms from $r(q_AA)$ to $R_v(q_{B_v}(s_0FA))$:
$$\mathsf T_v\bigl(\theta_{q_AA};s(\alpha_A);\zeta_{FA}\bigr)=\rho_A;q_{A_v}\bigl(r_0(\eta^0_A);\tau_{FA}\bigr);\iota_{v,s_0FA}.$$
The transformations $\alpha,\iota,\iota_v,\theta,\beta,\tau$ need not be invertible, and no localization, exactness, flatness or resolution hypothesis is imposed on these categories and functors.
